scenario.name: Test: parameterised website SQLi auth bypass (attacker + target)
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Two-VM test scenario for the agentic pipeline's tier-3 (exploit) testing (Phase 1C), exercising the non-Metasploit HTTP-exploit path. A Debian 12 target runs the Random Parameterised Website (a bespoke SecGen PHP app with no upstream CVE, hence no Metasploit module); a Kali attacker sits on the same private network. The module's secgen_test uses the framework helper test_http_exploit to POST a SQL injection to /login_process.php from the attacker over the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent and proves an authentication bypass from the 302 redirect to index.php. Both systems share a 10.91.0.0/24 private network (logical VLAN 1): IP_addresses[0] 10.91.0.10 is the target, [1] 10.91.0.20 is the attacker.
